records.source: Shrimp Donut
records.translation: Donut ng Hipon
records.englishResidueReason: Donut is the conventional Filipino food loanword.

records.source: Smell Of The Sea
records.translation: Amoy ng Dagat

records.source: Desert Gumbo
records.translation: Gumbo ng Disyerto
records.englishResidueReason: Gumbo is the proper Louisiana dish name.

records.source: Chef: Pity. Come back when you're ready for something delicious.
records.translation: Kusinero: Sayang. Bumalik ka kapag handa ka na sa masarap na pagkain.

records.source: Race Announcer: The racers need some time to prepare... Come back later!
records.translation: Tagapagbalita ng Karera: Kailangan ng mga mananakbo ng oras upang maghanda... Bumalik ka mamaya!

records.source: Race Announcer: Guess the winner and receive some fabulous prizes!
records.translation: Tagapagbalita ng Karera: Hulaan ang mananalo at tumanggap ng mga kahanga-hangang premyo!

records.source: Race Announcer: Who do you think will win?
records.translation: Tagapagbalita ng Karera: Sino sa palagay mo ang mananalo?

records.source: Race Announcer: {0}? Okay. Now sit back and enjoy the race!
records.translation: Tagapagbalita ng Karera: {0}? Sige. Umupo ka at masiyahan sa karera!

records.source: Race Announcer: Let's see if {0} can pull this off!
records.translation: Tagapagbalita ng Karera: Tingnan natin kung magagawa ito ni {0}!

records.source: Race Announcer: Escar-go... how?? Um...Well, here's your big payout...
records.translation: Tagapagbalita ng Karera: Escar-go... paano?? Um... Buweno, narito ang malaking napanalunan mo...
records.englishResidueReason: Escar-go is the racer's proper punning name.

records.source: Race Announcer: Congratulations! Here's your prize!
records.translation: Tagapagbalita ng Karera: Binabati kita! Narito ang premyo mo!

records.source: Race Announcer: Whoops. Looks like the race has already started. Try again later!
records.translation: Tagapagbalita ng Karera: Ay. Mukhang nagsimula na ang karera. Subukan muli mamaya!

records.source: Race Announcer: The race is currently in progress! Let's talk later...
records.translation: Tagapagbalita ng Karera: Kasalukuyang nagaganap ang karera! Mag-usap tayo mamaya...

records.source: Race Announcer: The races have ended for the day. I hope you had fun!
records.translation: Tagapagbalita ng Karera: Tapos na ang mga karera ngayong araw. Sana ay nasiyahan ka!

records.source: The next race is about to begin...
records.translation: Magsisimula na ang susunod na karera...

records.source: On your marks...
records.translation: Pumuwesto...

records.source: Get set...
records.translation: Humanda...

records.source: GO!
records.translation: TAKBO!

records.source: Finish!
records.translation: Tapos!

records.source: That was a close one!
records.translation: Dikitan iyon!

records.source: It was neck-and-neck!
records.translation: Tabla sila hanggang dulo!

records.source: Such speed has rarely been seen!
records.translation: Bihirang makakita ng ganoong bilis!

records.source: And now, the moment you've all been waiting for...
records.translation: At ngayon, ang sandaling hinihintay ninyong lahat...

records.source: That's the last race for today. We'll see you tomorrow!
records.translation: Iyon ang huling karera ngayong araw. Magkita tayo bukas!

records.source: And that's it for this year's races! See you next time!
records.translation: At iyan na ang mga karera ngayong taon! Magkita tayo sa susunod!

records.source: This race's winner is...
records.translation: Ang nanalo sa karerang ito ay...

records.source: Come by to collect your prize!
records.translation: Dumaan upang kunin ang iyong premyo!

records.source: Better luck next time!
records.translation: Sana palarin ka sa susunod!

records.source: Speed Rooster
records.translation: Mabilis na Tandang

records.source: King Sting
records.translation: Haring Pantusok

records.source: Shoebiscuit
records.translation: Sapatos-Biskwit

records.source: Escar-go
records.preserveReason: Escar-go is the racer's proper punning name.

records.source: Cactus Crawler
records.translation: Gumagapang na Kaktus

records.source: Suspicious Guy: Heh... not now, kid. Come back later, and we can talk.
records.translation: Kahina-hinalang Lalaki: Heh... huwag ngayon, bata. Bumalik ka mamaya at mag-usap tayo.

records.source: Suspicious Guy: It's too late, kid. Come back when the races are happening.
records.translation: Kahina-hinalang Lalaki: Huli na, bata. Bumalik ka kapag nagaganap ang mga karera.

records.source: Suspicious Guy: Eyes on the race, kid! We can talk later...
records.translation: Kahina-hinalang Lalaki: Pagtuunan mo ang karera, bata! Mag-usap tayo mamaya...

records.source: Suspicious Guy: Too late, the race's started. Let's talk again later...
records.translation: Kahina-hinalang Lalaki: Huli na, nagsimula na ang karera. Mag-usap ulit tayo mamaya...

records.source: Suspicious Guy: Psst... Hey, kid. You been watching these races? Pretty exciting, huh?
records.translation: Kahina-hinalang Lalaki: Psst... Hoy, bata. Pinanonood mo ba ang mga karerang ito? Kapanapanabik, ano?

records.source: Suspicious Guy: ... Say, I got a little 'proposition' for ya.
records.translation: Kahina-hinalang Lalaki: ... May munting 'alok' ako sa iyo.

records.source: Suspicious Guy: Just pick a racer, and their next race will be a real stinker... catch my drift?
records.translation: Kahina-hinalang Lalaki: Pumili ka lang ng mananakbo at talagang sasablay ang susunod niyang karera... nauunawaan mo?
